title: 34.1 Honest floor v2 does not stop the agent proposing real fixes
notes: Frozen 8 Oct 2026 BEFORE the run. The review of 2.1.3 warned the floor ('never fill the gap from the descriptions') may make the agent decline instead of proposing a fix. Measured with the app's own agent (Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, as F2) on Tears of Steel descriptions the independent judge labelled WRONG (a fix must be proposed) and RIGHT (no change). tools/honest_bench.py --set propose, 'on' = v2 floor, 'off' = no floor.

metrics.why: the floor may cost at most 10 points of fixes proposed for wrong descriptions
the floor may not make the agent change correct descriptions more than 10 points more often
